# PRODUCT SPEC

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

This application is:

The public website for AB Recording Studio. It shows visitors who the studio is, which musicians have recorded there, and promotes the studio's upcoming free music festival.

Version 1 is a hard-coded static site: all content lives in typed files in /content and is edited in code. No database, no login, no admin area.

Visitors can:
- Browse the musicians the studio has worked with, and open a profile for each (bio, photo, credits, links)
- Read the studio's background: story, history, rooms and gear, team
- See the upcoming festival: dates, venue, lineup, schedule. Entry is free (no ticket sales).
- Contact the studio by email: binauanders@gmail.com (mailto link, no form)

Primary Entities (hard-coded in /content):
Musician, MusicianCredit, AboutSection, Festival, LineupSlot, StudioInfo

User Types:
visitor — anonymous, read-only

## Site tabs (main navigation)
1. Home
2. Musicians (artists the studio has worked with)
3. Background (about the studio)
4. Festival (upcoming free music festival)
5. Contact

## Later (not in v1)
Admin area with Supabase so content can be edited without code. Planned schema kept in database.md under "Future".
